title: Painted Arrows
reference: F1 F1 forward def DASH { F1 F1 forward } def F1 { while not wall_ahead { forward } if tile_is r { turn_right } else { turn_left } }
hints: At the end of every hall the floor says which way: red means right, blue means left.
F1: walk to the wall, then if the tile is red turn right, else turn left. Each bot: F1, F1, forward.
F1 F1 forward def DASH { F1 F1 forward } def F1 { while not wall_ahead { forward } if tile_is r { turn_right } else { turn_left } }

story.intro: BULWARK: "Somebody painted arrows in the cell block. Red means right, blue means left. Each of you reads your own floor."
